name: ui-previewer
description: Click Preview above any React component to render it in a side panel with auto-generated dummy props.

componentPreviewer.globalCss.description: Workspace-relative path to a global stylesheet to load in every preview (e.g. src/index.css, or your compiled Tailwind output).

componentPreviewer.fillOptionalProps.description: Also generate dummy values for optional props (excluding ones inherited from node_modules typings).

enumDescriptions: Show the Preview link on the first line of the file
Show the Preview link above each component
